title: Yahtzee
chooseLength: How long should the game be?
shortHint: 6 rounds: ones to sixes. Good for practice.
wholeHint: 13 rounds: all fields of the score sheet.
mode_erklaeren: Explain mode: The coach shows the chances with every throw and explains where they come from.
mode_joker: Game with joker: You play yourself. When you are stuck, ask the joker. After every move the trainer tells you how it was.
mode_spielen: Plain game: no help, you collect points for the high-score list.
scoreNow: Enter {field} now. Throwing again does not pay off.
treeIntro: Free dice: {free}. How often is at least one {face} among them?
treeLabel: Probability tree for {free} free dice and the number {face}
twoIntro: And with two throws? Then no {face} may come in either throw.
tipField: and enter {field} in the end: about {points} points.
noTree: There is no simple tree for this throw. Compare the fields.
jokerLevel1: Free dice: {free}. A way counts if at least one {face} is among them.
jokerLevel2: The branches are filled in. Chances along a way are multiplied.
jokerLevel3: Here is the solution. See how the ways fit together.
task1: Write the chance of each branch (as a fraction).
task2: Work out one way, then add up the green ways.
scoreBest: {field} with {points} points: that was the best choice.

scoreBetter: {field} with {points} points: {best} with {bestPoints} points would have been better here.
